parsed.rationale: All four records are type-alias-objects named `SequentialMockSession` nested inside test-suite types (`iTunesArtworkServiceTests`, `LastFMArtworkServiceTests`, `DiscogsArtworkServiceTests`) and live in `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift`. Although none carry `is_test=true` in the context flags, the file path (`Tests/ArtworkTests/`) and the enclosing type names (all suffixed `Tests`) make clear these are test-scoped type aliases. The `fields_or_signature` list is empty for every record, so there is no shared implementation body to extract — only a shared alias name. Consolidating them into a single top-level alias would couple three independent test suites and obscure which mock session belongs to which service under test, which is the canonical reason such aliases are repeated per-suite.
